summary.text: Peter Herzberg is a Democratic state representative from Michigan House District 25 who took office on April 30, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which Republican Dawn Udell is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Peter Herzberg graduated from John Glenn High School and obtained a bachelor's degree in finance from Wayne State University.
As of the 2024 election, Herzberg was a certified home inspector.
Herzberg won the January 30, 2024 special Democratic primary and the April 16, 2024 special general election for District 25, and he took office on April 30, 2024.
He won a full term in the November 5, 2024 general election, defeating Republican Josh Powell, and advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed.

In the 2025-2026 session he sits on the Energy and the Rules and Competitiveness committees and is minority vice chair of the Select Committee on Protecting Michigan Employees and Small Businesses and of the Transportation Committee.
